title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Strong Enough to Say "I Was Wrong"
caption:
A godly man can look any man in the eye and still say, I was wrong.

Short. Specific. For the other man, not for your image. God opposes the proud and gives grace to the humble, so this is where the grace is.

Who are you carrying an apology for?

#faith #humility #godlymen #christianman #manofgod #apology
